data.narrative:
Sunfire is a Series E climate and energy technology company that has raised $315M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of nine comparable firms in the climate and energy sector—one public (Lonza, ticker LNZA) and eight private companies including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Due to the sparse distribution of direct comparables at Sunfire's stage and valuation tier within climate tech, only one triangulation method yielded sufficient data. The stage-progression approach applies a typical 1.4x step-up multiplier from Series E to next-stage funding, using the $315M total raised as a proxy baseline. This method implies a valuation of $441M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $375M to $507M, with a median point of $441M. This range reflects a ±15% band around the implied figure. The primary uncertainty stems from the limited comparable set at this stage and scale within frontier climate tech; broader peer cohorts exist but introduce sector heterogeneity. Investors should weight this analysis alongside operational milestones, technology differentiation, and market timing factors not captured in this purely quantitative framework.
